doc.brief: The QLayout class is the base class of geometry managers.
doc.index_brief: The base class of geometry managers

QLayout(QWidget *parent).brief: Constructs a new top-level QLayout, with parent *parent*.

QLayout::SizeConstraint horizontalSizeCo.brief: This property holds the horizontal size constraint.

QLayout::SizeConstraint sizeConstraint().brief: This property holds the resize mode of the layout.

QLayout::SizeConstraint verticalSizeCons.brief: This property holds the vertical size constraint.

QLayoutItem * itemAt(int index) const =.brief: Must be implemented in subclasses to return the layout item at *index*.

QLayoutItem * replaceWidget(QWidget *fro.brief: Searches for widget *from* and replaces it with widget *to* if found.

QLayoutItem * takeAt(int index) = 0.brief: Must be implemented in subclasses to remove the layout item at *index* from the layout, and return the item.

QMargins contentsMargins() const.brief: Returns the margins used around the layout.

QRect alignmentRect(const QRect &r) cons.brief: Returns the rectangle that should be covered when the geometry of this layout is set to *r*, provided that this layout supports [setAlignment](xref:qt:QLayout)().

QRect contentsRect() const.brief: Returns the layout's [geometry](xref:qt:QLayout)() rectangle, but taking into account the contents margins.

QSize closestAcceptableSize(const QWidge.brief: Returns a size that satisfies all size constraints on *widget*, including [heightForWidth](xref:qt:QLayoutItem)() and that is as close as possible to *size*.

QWidget * menuBar() const.brief: Returns the menu bar set for this layout, or `nullptr` if no menu bar is set.

QWidget * parentWidget() const.brief: Returns the parent widget of this layout, or `nullptr` if this layout is not installed on any widget.

bool activate().brief: Redoes the layout for [parentWidget](xref:qt:QLayout)() if necessary.

bool isEnabled() const.brief: Returns `true` if the layout is enabled; otherwise returns `false`.

bool setAlignment(QLayout *l, Qt::Alignm.brief: Sets the alignment for the layout *l* to *alignment* and returns `true` if *l* is found in this layout (not including child layouts); otherwise returns `false`.

bool setAlignment(QWidget *w, Qt::Alignm.brief: Sets the alignment for widget *w* to *alignment* and returns true if *w* is found in this layout (not including child layouts); otherwise returns `false`.

int count() const = 0.brief: Must be implemented in subclasses to return the number of items in the layout.

int indexOf(const QLayoutItem *layoutIte.brief: Searches for layout item *layoutItem* in this layout (not including child layouts).

int indexOf(const QWidget *widget) const.brief: Searches for widget *widget* in this layout (not including child layouts).

int spacing() const.brief: This property holds the spacing between widgets inside the layout

void addChildLayout(QLayout *childLayout.brief: This function is called from `addLayout()` or `insertLayout()` functions in subclasses to add layout *childLayout* as a sub-layout.

void addChildWidget(QWidget *w).brief: This function is called from `addWidget()` functions in subclasses to add *w* as a managed widget of a layout.

void addItem(QLayoutItem *item) = 0.brief: Implemented in subclasses to add an *item*.

void addWidget(QWidget *w).brief: Adds widget *w* to this layout in a manner specific to the layout.

void getContentsMargins(int *left, int *.brief: For each of *left*, *top*, *right* and *bottom* that is not `nullptr`, stores the size of the margin named in the location the pointer refers to.

void removeItem(QLayoutItem *item).brief: Removes the layout item *item* from the layout.

void removeWidget(QWidget *widget).brief: Removes the widget *widget* from the layout.

void setContentsMargins(const QMargins &.brief: Sets the *margins* to use around the layout.

void setContentsMargins(int left, int to.brief: Sets the *left*, *top*, *right*, and *bottom* margins to use around the layout.

void setEnabled(bool enable).brief: Enables this layout if *enable* is true, otherwise disables it.

void setHorizontalSizeConstraint(QLayout.brief: This property holds the horizontal size constraint.

void setMenuBar(QWidget *widget).brief: Tells the geometry manager to place the menu bar *widget* at the top of [parentWidget](xref:qt:QLayout)(), outside [QWidget::contentsMargins](xref:qt:QWidget)().

void setSizeConstraint(QLayout::SizeCons.brief: This property holds the resize mode of the layout.

void setSizeConstraints(QLayout::SizeCon.brief: Sets both the *horizontal* and *vertical* size constraints.

void setSpacing(int).brief: This property holds the spacing between widgets inside the layout

void setVerticalSizeConstraint(QLayout::.brief: This property holds the vertical size constraint.

void unsetContentsMargins().brief: Unsets any user-defined margins around the layout.

contentsMargins.brief: The margins used around the layout

sizeConstraint.brief: The resize mode of the layout. Setting the size constraint for the dialog. Setting a vertical or horizontal size constraint will override this

spacing.brief: The spacing between widgets inside the layout
